subject: Take two of The signal in the new shot-direction structure (eyeline UP and to the CHARACTER'S RIGHT, viewer-left; the read is concern; Ziggy's note verbatim); the reusable SHOT_DIRECTION_TEMPLATE; the earlier delta marked superseded
body:
Ziggy's correction applied, not inverted: the eyeline goes UP and to HIS RIGHT, which is VIEWER-LEFT in this frontal setup (his raised right hand is at the frame's left edge, the teammates are off-screen above that edge on the higher dune behind the camera's left shoulder); the read is concern. His note is in the card verbatim: "Look over off-screen, UP TO YOUR RIGHT, and indicate to your teammates that it's concern."

Two files attached.
1. SHOT_DIRECTION_SIGNAL_002_20261014.md, sha256 7bbd7a78159ce55d4aa795f045d23485d3f8506ca8e206540d6977c8720eb2a0, 9,764 bytes: the operative card for take two. Sections: SHOT; SOURCE LINEAGE (the L19 frame by hash; take one by hash, preserved, graded from frames L4 S5 performance static); LIGHTING (the haze key, the fire as the only practical and how it flares and gutters); CAMERA (locked; the line and the edges); CHARACTER DIRECTION (the acting note; the eyeline with both sides written; the face with the mouth closed; two small palm pushes toward the teammates; what does not move); BACKGROUND ACTION; TIME BEATS (one table, four columns coordinated, 0 to 8 s as story design); RESULTING PROMPT (copy-ready, section 7; trim for the route's limit without changing a side); then your TECHNICAL SETTINGS (8) and ACTUAL RESULTS (9) to fill, and ACCEPTANCE (10) kept separate: a good scene is not an approved performance; take two is one new variable (the performance) against take one.
2. SHOT_DIRECTION_TEMPLATE.md, sha256 8ac472a9353b8ce370cbac2dae4e1b1dcb781e5a30fcaec346a091565398b75a, 4,532 bytes: the reusable structure every storyboard shot carries from here, with its rules (every side written as the character's and the viewer's; one new variable per take; originals preserved; the prompt derived from the card, never the reverse; the writer touches sections 0 to 7, you fill 8 and 9, acceptance is 10 and nobody's but Ziggy's). For Site Nova to expose as authored sections.

SIGNAL_PERFORMANCE_DELTA_20261014.md is kept and marked superseded, its eyeline lines corrected to match (sha256 46aeeee1a064803b8539f467896f20afb43d7b500d77df4860c9662a93b71281). DECISIONS item 54 records the correction and the structure direction (file sha256 8c2436f0c0ddfdfc41542e1a0db59fdd090ca918838351f2fd94102d7afc839f, 68,946 bytes); START_HERE.txt sha256 9cb509da280490ecda705e20deaf96f69a7f4266ebecc2c50e355bbf8755d805.

On return: first, middle, last and the two push beats, and I grade with the performance line. A one-agent fact check of the card is running; any correction comes in this thread before you run if it lands in time, otherwise as a note on the take.
